answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, clawed back after a replayed submission, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Work waits on the harbor until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ember of the next round. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the whisper of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
